title: Positive, negative or zero
description: Write a function `classify_number(n)` that returns the string "positive", "negative" or "zero" depending on the value of `n`.
hints: You need to compare `n` against zero using comparison operators.
Use if / elif / else: first check n > 0, then n < 0, then the remaining case.
expected_behavior: Returns exactly one of "positive", "negative", "zero" as a string.
explanation: We compare n against 0 with if/elif/else. Only one branch runs, and else covers the remaining case (n == 0) without needing an explicit comparison.
